dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.23

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG BEETS_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    build-base \
    cairo-dev \
    cargo \
    cmake \
    ffmpeg-dev \
    fftw-dev \
    git \
    gobject-introspection-dev \
    jpeg-dev \
    libedit-dev \
    libpng-dev \
    mpg123-dev \
    openjpeg-dev \
    python3-dev && \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    chromaprint \
    expat \
    ffmpeg \
    fftw \
    flac \
    gdbm \
    gobject-introspection \
    gst-plugins-good \
    gstreamer \
    imagemagick \
    jpeg \
    lame \
    libffi \
    libpng \
    mpg123 \
    mp3gain \
    nano \
    openjpeg \
    python3 \
    sqlite-libs && \
  echo "**** install beets ****" && \
  if [ -z ${BEETS_VERSION+x} ] ; then \
    BEETS_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/beetbox/beets/commits/master" \
    | jq -r .sha); \
  fi && \
  git clone https://github.com/beetbox/beets.git /tmp/beets && \
  cd /tmp/beets && \
  git checkout -f "${BEETS_VERSION}" && \
  echo "**** compile mp3val ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /tmp/mp3val-src && \
  curl -o \
  /tmp/mp3val-src/mp3val.tar.gz -sL \
    https://downloads.sourceforge.net/mp3val/mp3val-0.1.8-src.tar.gz && \
  cd /tmp/mp3val-src && \
  tar xzf /tmp/mp3val-src/mp3val.tar.gz --strip 1 && \
  make -f Makefile.linux && \
  cp -p mp3val /usr/bin && \
  echo "**** install pip packages ****" && \
  python3 -m venv /lsiopy && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir \
    pip \
    setuptools && \
  echo "**** install beets ****" && \
  cd /tmp/beets && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.23/ . && \
  echo "**** install pip packages ****" && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.23/ \
    beautifulsoup4 \
    beets-extrafiles \
    beetcamp \
    python3-discogs-client \
    flask \
    flask-cors \
    PyGObject \
    pyacoustid \
    pylast \
    requests \
    requests_oauthlib \
    typing-extensions \
    unidecode && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    $HOME/.cache \
    $HOME/.cargo

# environment settings
ENV BEETSDIR="/config" \
EDITOR="nano" \
HOME="/config"

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8337
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-beets-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# copy config
cp -n /defaults/beets.sh /config/beets.sh
cp -n /defaults/config.yaml /config/config.yaml

chmod +x /config/beets.sh

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    # permissions
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /config
fi

units.name: svc-beets
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8337" \
            s6-setuidgid abc beet web
else
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8337" \
            beet web
fi

notes.upstream:
Fix empty db migration backup (#7171)

## Description

Fixes #7170.

When beets creates a new library, it runs every migration on the fresh
database,
and each one made a backup first. A brand-new, empty library ended up
with 11
`.bak` files and 11 "Created database backup" lines, even for `beet
version`.

This PR makes `_before_migration_backup` in `beets/dbcore/db.py` skip
the
backup when the table being migrated has no rows (`SELECT 1 FROM <table>
LIMIT 1`).
An empty table has no data for a migration to change, so there's nothing
to
protect. The migrations still run and are still recorded, so they won't
be
retried on the next start.

Tables that contain data are backed up exactly as before.

**Before:** fresh `BEETSDIR` + `beet version` → 11 `.bak` files.
**After:** fresh `BEETSDIR` + `beet version` → 0 `.bak` files, 11
migrations recorded.

## To Do

- [x] ~Documentation.~ (bug fix, no user-facing option changes)
- [x] Changelog.
- [x] Tests. Added `test_no_backup_for_empty_table` to
`TestMigrationBackup`. It
fails without the fix and passes with it; the existing
`test_backup_config`
  (which expects one backup when the table has data) still passes.

`poe lint`, `poe check-format` and `poe lint-docs` pass. The full test
suite
passes locally except `test_importfeeds.py::test_link_creates_symlink`,
which
also fails on unmodified `master` on Windows (symlinks need admin or
Developer
Mode) and is unrelated.

---

*AI disclosure: An AI assistant (Claude) helped me find and reproduce
this bug,
explained the code, suggested the approach, and drafted this
description. I
wrote the code change and the test myself and can answer questions about
them.*
